description: Keep everything on a contract and readjust as necessary #readjusting #selflove #selfcare
transcript: I live in reality by readjusting my expectations. I live in reality because I put everything in my life on a 30, 60, 90, and a 120-day contract. The more that I live in those seasons of reevaluation, I am able to see things for what they are, not what I wish them to be. The more that I've put things on contracts, the more that I'm able to see stipulations, the more that I'm able to see the way that I show up, the more that I'm willing to allow things to reveal itself on its own without me forcing responses.
